thread:
maria: Heads up — HF importer failed during onboarding for a new model (gpt-mini-emba). getting weird tokenization shifts and chat template parsing errors.

kai: Logs?

maria: paste:
```
ERROR: safetensors: shard list truncated: expected 4 shards, got 3 (last URL returned 401)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/importer.py", line 412, in _fetch_shards
    weights = load_safetensors(shard_path)
KeyError: 'transformer.h.0.mlp.fc.weight'
```

aaron: 401 from the hub CDN on shard_3.safetensors — looks like an auth token expired mid-download.

jen: If one shard is missing during the weight-key rewrite step, the weightname->tensor alignment can shift and produce wrong token ids. That would explain special token id mismatch and the chat template failing to find the system token.

maria: confirmed: tokenizer.json contains the special tokens, but the chat template parser fails because the priming token id in the model (post-conversion) no longer matches the tokenizer mapping.

kai: Quick mitigation ideas:
- fail-fast in importer if shard count != manifest.expected_shards
- HEAD-check all shard URLs and validate sha256 before any weight key renaming
- on 401/403 do a single credential refresh + retry with backoff; don't silently proceed

aaron: Agree. Also add a fallback: try fetching the model by pinned revision (if present in metadata) when the default/latest revision returns auth errors. Many hubs have public pinned archives even if latest requires auth.

jen: Additionally, weight key renames should be applied using per-shard manifests (preserve index ordering), not a single global mapping. I'll sketch a change to the importer weight-map logic so it computes expected key->shard mapping using the safetensors index.

sync-bot: Note: eng-ml/importer#912 created. Items: preflight HEAD+sha256, auth-refresh-on-401, fallback-to-pinned-revision, per-shard key mapping.

kai: Test plan: create a minimal repro with 4 shards where one shard URL returns 401 on first attempt (simulate expired token) and verify importer: a) retries and succeeds after refresh; b) if not refreshed, fails cleanly with no partial weight rewrites; c) quant/eval runs compare token ids and sample chat prompt outputs.

maria: I'll attach the repro (small weights + tokenizer + chat_template.json) in the PR. Also will include a small script that simulates token expiry with curl to reproduce the 401 sequence. Example curl to simulate header mismatch:
```
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer EXPIRED" https://cdn.hf.co/models/org/model/shard_3.safetensors
```

aaron: tagging @security for review on the credential refresh flow. we need to ensure we don't leak credentials in logs and that refresh follows existing oauth flow.

jen: I'll review once the PR lands. thanks for the repro, maria. :thumbsup:

maria: PR coming in ~30m. I'll also add an integration test that asserts chat templates survive import for at least 3 sample prompts.

aaron: Nice. moving to blocking until PR merged.

jen: ack.
